answer.rationale: The scenario describes a work-related amputation with in-patient hospitalization, which is both a recordable event under §1904.4(a)/§1904.7(a) and requires OSHA recording on the 300 Log/301 form within 7 days (§1904.29(b)(3)), plus a mandatory 24-hour report to OSHA under §1904.39(a)(2) since the employer learned of it today. These requirements are directly supported by the given facts without need for further information.
